quiz.q: Which team signed 13-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, the youngest IPL contract signee?
quiz.solution: Rajasthan Royals bought him for Rs 1.1 crore at the November 2024 mega auction.

quiz.q: Which country joined the International Solar Alliance as its 104th full member in November 2024?
quiz.solution: Armenia's membership was effective November 15, 2024; the ISA is headquartered in Gurugram.

quiz.q: Which state's alliance won the November 2024 assembly election in Jharkhand?
quiz.solution: The JMM-led alliance won a majority in the Jharkhand assembly polls held November 13-20, 2024.

items.headline: PM Modi's visit to Nigeria, Brazil and Guyana
items.detail: PM Narendra Modi visited Nigeria, Brazil and Guyana from November 16-21, 2024. He attended the G20 Summit in Rio de Janeiro. It was the first visit by an Indian PM to Nigeria in 17 years and to Guyana in 56 years.
examFacts: First PM visit to Guyana in 56 years

items.headline: Assam renames Karimganj district as Sribhumi
items.detail: The Assam cabinet approved renaming Karimganj district as 'Sribhumi', a name meaning the land of Maa Lakshmi, used by Rabindranath Tagore.

items.headline: India unveils world's first Green Steel Taxonomy
items.detail: Steel Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy launched India's Green Steel Taxonomy on December 12, 2024, making India the first country to define green steel. The emissions limit was set at 2.2 tonnes of CO2 per tonne of finished steel.
examFacts: First country with green steel taxonomy
Limit: 2.2 tCO2 per tonne of finished steel

items.headline: President assents to Bharatiya Vayuyan Vidheyak
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu gave assent to the Bharatiya Vayuyan Vidheyak, 2024, which replaces the nine-decade-old Aircraft Act of 1934 to govern civil aviation in India.

items.headline: Rs 13,500 crore deal for 12 Su-30MKI jets
items.detail: The Ministry of Defence signed a Rs 13,500 crore contract with HAL for 12 indigenous Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter jets for the Indian Air Force, part of the 'Super Sukhoi' upgrade programme.

items.headline: India win Women's Hockey Junior Asia Cup
items.detail: India beat China in a penalty shootout in Muscat, Oman to win the Women's Hockey Junior Asia Cup for the second straight time. Deepika Sehrawat was the top scorer with 12 goals.

items.headline: Jay Shah takes over as ICC Chairman
items.detail: Jay Shah, former BCCI Secretary, took over as the independent Chairman of the International Cricket Council (ICC) from December 1, 2024. Shammi Silva of Sri Lanka succeeded him as President of the Asian Cricket Council (ACC).

items.headline: New chief for BrahMos Aerospace
items.detail: Dr Jaiteerth Raghavendra Joshi took over as CEO and Managing Director of BrahMos Aerospace from December 1, 2024, succeeding Atul Dinkar Rane. BrahMos is a joint venture of DRDO with Russia's NPO Mashinostroyeniya.
examFacts: BrahMos CEO & MD: Jaiteerth Raghavendra Joshi

items.headline: Government scraps windfall tax and road cess on fuel
items.detail: The Finance Ministry withdrew the windfall tax (Special Additional Excise Duty) on crude oil, petrol, diesel and ATF, and also removed the Road and Infrastructure Cess. The windfall tax had been imposed in July 2022.

items.headline: South Korean President declares short-lived martial law
items.detail: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol declared emergency martial law on December 3, 2024, but the National Assembly voted unanimously to lift it and he rescinded it within hours.
examFacts: Lifted within hours by Assembly vote

items.headline: French PM Barnier's government falls
items.detail: French Prime Minister Michel Barnier lost a no-confidence vote on December 4, 2024, with 331 of 577 deputies voting against his government, the first such fall since 1962.

items.headline: RBI cuts CRR, trims FY25 growth view
items.detail: At its fifth bi-monthly policy of FY25, the RBI cut the cash reserve ratio to 4% and lowered its FY25 GDP growth forecast to 6.6%, while raising the inflation projection to 4.8%.

items.headline: Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah set to be Namibia's first woman President
items.detail: SWAPO's Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah was certified winner of Namibia's presidential election, becoming the country's first female President.

items.headline: ISRO's PSLV launches ESA's Proba-3 satellites
items.detail: ISRO's PSLV-XL launched the European Space Agency's Proba-3 satellites, a solar observatory mission that will study the Sun's corona, on December 5, 2024.

items.headline: Michelle Bachelet to get Indira Gandhi Peace Prize 2024
items.detail: Former Chilean President Michelle Bachelet was chosen for the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development 2024, which carries Rs 25 lakh. The jury was chaired by former NSA Shivshankar Menon.

items.headline: 100-day TB elimination campaign launched
items.detail: Health Minister JP Nadda launched a 100-day TB elimination campaign on December 7, 2024 from Panchkula, Haryana, covering 347 districts and introducing the BPaLM treatment regimen.

items.headline: Human Rights Day 2024 observed
items.detail: Human Rights Day was observed on December 10, 2024 with the theme 'Our Rights, Our Future, Right Now', marking the 76th anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
examFacts: Theme: 'Our Rights, Our Future, Right Now'

items.headline: Former Karnataka CM S.M. Krishna passes away
items.detail: S.M. Krishna, former Chief Minister of Karnataka (1999-2004) and former Maharashtra Governor, died at the age of 92. He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2023.

items.headline: Sanjay Malhotra sworn in as RBI Governor
items.detail: Sanjay Malhotra was sworn in as Governor of the Reserve Bank of India on December 11, 2024, succeeding Shaktikanta Das.

items.headline: Gukesh becomes youngest World Chess Champion
items.detail: Eighteen-year-old Grandmaster D Gukesh of Chennai became the youngest ever World Chess Champion, winning the world title match in December 2024.

items.headline: Vijay Diwas observed on December 16
items.detail: The 53rd Vijay Diwas was observed on December 16, 2024, marking Pakistan's surrender in Dhaka in 1971 and India's victory in the Liberation War of Bangladesh.

items.headline: 'One Nation, One Election' bill moved in Lok Sabha
items.detail: A Constitution amendment bill for simultaneous state and national elections was moved in the Lok Sabha on December 17, 2024, but failed to get the required two-thirds majority for introduction, with the government deciding to send it for further examination.

items.headline: ISRO tests CE20 cryogenic engine for Gaganyaan
items.detail: ISRO carried out a sea-level hot test of the CE20 cryogenic engine with a nozzle area ratio of 100 at the ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu. The engine powers the LVM3 upper stage and is certified for 20 tonnes of thrust for Gaganyaan.

items.headline: ISRO begins launch campaign for Gaganyaan's first uncrewed flight
items.detail: ISRO began the HLVM3-G1 launch campaign at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota for Gaganyaan's first uncrewed mission. The HLVM3 rocket is about 53 m tall, weighs 640 tonnes and can lift 10 tonnes to low Earth orbit.

items.headline: Chinese astronauts set nine-hour spacewalk record
items.detail: Shenzhou-19 astronauts Cai Xuzhe and Song Lingdong carried out a nine-hour spacewalk outside the Tiangong space station, beating the previous NASA record of 8 hours 56 minutes.

items.headline: First World Meditation Day observed
items.detail: The first UN World Meditation Day was observed on December 21, 2024. The UNGA resolution was co-sponsored by India, Sri Lanka, Liechtenstein, Andorra, Mexico and Nepal.

items.headline: India State of Forest Report 2023 released
items.detail: The 18th India State of Forest Report was released at FRI Dehradun on December 21, 2024. Forest and tree cover stood at 8,27,357 sq km, 25.17% of India's area, with Madhya Pradesh having the largest forest cover.

items.headline: 55th GST Council meeting held in Jaisalmer
items.detail: The 55th GST Council meeting, chaired by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, was held in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. GST on fortified rice kernels was cut to 5% and gene therapy was fully exempted.

items.headline: Governors appointed for five states
items.detail: The President appointed governors for five states: Rajendra Arlekar for Kerala, Hari Babu Kambhampati for Odisha, Arif Mohammed Khan for Bihar, General V.K. Singh (retd) for Mizoram and Ajay Kumar Bhalla for Manipur.

items.headline: Osamu Suzuki, Maruti-Suzuki pioneer, dies at 94
items.detail: Osamu Suzuki, former Chairman and CEO of Suzuki Motor Corporation who led the company for over 40 years, died at 94. He drove the 1982 joint venture that created Maruti Udyog in India and received the Padma Bhushan in 2007.

items.headline: Former US President Jimmy Carter dies at 100
items.detail: Jimmy Carter, the 39th President of the United States (1977-81) known for the Camp David Accords, died at the age of 100. He won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2002 and was the longest-living US president.

items.headline: Justice V. Ramasubramanian appointed NHRC Chairperson
items.detail: Justice V. Ramasubramanian was appointed the ninth Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission for a three-year term, succeeding Justice Arun Kumar Mishra.

quiz.q: Who became the youngest ever World Chess Champion in December 2024?
quiz.solution: 18-year-old D Gukesh of Chennai became the youngest ever World Chess Champion.

quiz.q: Who succeeded Shaktikanta Das as RBI Governor in December 2024?
quiz.solution: Sanjay Malhotra was sworn in as RBI Governor on December 11, 2024.

quiz.q: As per the India State of Forest Report 2023, what percentage of India's area is under forest and tree cover?
quiz.solution: ISFR 2023 put forest and tree cover at 8,27,357 sq km, or 25.17% of the area; MP had the largest forest cover.

quiz.q: Jimmy Carter, who passed away in December 2024, was the ___ President of the United States.
quiz.solution: Carter, the 39th US President, won the 2002 Nobel Peace Prize and lived to 100.

quiz.q: In December 2024, the President of which country declared a short-lived martial law?
quiz.solution: South Korea's Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law on December 3, 2024; the Assembly voted to lift it within hours.

quiz.q: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Vidheyak, 2024, given assent by the President, replaces which colonial-era law?
quiz.solution: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Vidheyak replaces the Aircraft Act of 1934 to govern civil aviation.

quiz.q: Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah was set to become the first woman President of which country?
quiz.solution: The SWAPO leader won Namibia's presidential election in December 2024.

quiz.q: Who was chosen for the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development 2024?
quiz.solution: Former Chilean President Michelle Bachelet was chosen; the jury was chaired by Shivshankar Menon.

quiz.q: Which state's forest cover was the largest in the country as per ISFR 2023?
quiz.solution: Madhya Pradesh had the largest forest cover; India's forest and tree cover is 25.17% of its area.

quiz.q: India became the first country to launch a taxonomy for which product in December 2024?
quiz.solution: India's Green Steel Taxonomy set an emissions limit of 2.2 tonnes of CO2 per tonne of finished steel.
